title: Multiyear budget-impact analysis
primary_chapter_title: Economic Evaluation, Affordability, and Health Technology Assessment
purpose: Estimates annual and cumulative financial consequences for a specific budget holder under low, base, and high adoption or effectiveness scenarios.
input: `Years` sheet with year, eligible population, adoption rates, per-user recurring cost, implementation cost, savings per user, and scenario multipliers; `Parameters` sheet with currency and perspective.
outputs: Annual base-case and scenario budget impact, cumulative budget impact, cost and savings decomposition, line chart, and decision summary.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
